Dogecoin & Shiba Inu Surge 6.4%

If you're a DOGE or SHIB fan, you're probably smiling right now.

Both cryptocurrencies skyrocketed 6.4% in 24 hours.

Reasons behind surge

- Shift in market sentiment, with S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 gains

Fartcoin (FARTCOIN) has experienced a significant surge, up 121% in the past month, contrasting with the more stable performance of Bitcoin and Dogecoin.
